steps.expression: (() => { const s1 = store.stage1Params; const s2 = store.stage2Params; if (!s1 || !s2 || !s1.inputParams || !s2.inputParams) return { canCompare: false }; const s1Set = new Set(s1.inputParams); const s2Set = new Set(s2.inputParams); const onlyInS1 = s1.inputParams.filter(p => !s2Set.has(p)); const onlyInS2 = s2.inputParams.filter(p => !s1Set.has(p)); const common = s1.inputParams.filter(p => s2Set.has(p)); const paramsDiffer = onlyInS1.length > 0 || onlyInS2.length > 0; return { canCompare: true, stage1Count: s1.inputParamCount, stage2Count: s2.inputParamCount, common, onlyInStage1: onlyInS1, onlyInStage2: onlyInS2, paramsDiffer, stage1Strategies: s1.strategyCount, stage2Strategies: s2.strategyCount, strategyCountDiffer: s1.strategyCount !== s2.strategyCount }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；链路id=20180存在；至少2个环节
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 刷标签环节(第1环节): 链路起点,无前序依赖,1个策略; 首图生图环节(第2环节): 依赖刷标签出参(season_tag/style_tag),4个策略
riskPoints: 不同环节入参字段集是否有差异(下游环节应多出上游计算字段)
策略数量是否正确(1 vs 4)
滚动后入参span坐标是否更新
_testDesign.crossStageLogic: 链路DAG中上游环节的出参=下游环节的入参基础,因此不同环节入参字段集应有差集
